nodes.label: Client page access key (lib/access.ts, t:<token> / p:<pageId>)
nodes.norm_label: client page access key (lib/access.ts, t:<token> / p:<pageid>)
nodes.rationale: One key resolves board actions, media URLs and zip downloads for both private-link visitors and logged-in owners/admin, letting the admin reuse client components.

nodes.label: getDb() Drizzle client (lib/db/index.ts)
nodes.rationale: Uses node-postgres when DATABASE_URL is set, otherwise falls back to PGlite at .data/pglite (single-process); e2e tests force PGlite with DATABASE_URL="".

nodes.label: Next.js 16.4 App Router (cacheComponents off)
nodes.rationale: Every page is per-user so pages render dynamically; DB-reading pages without cookies call await connection() to avoid build-time prerendering.

nodes.label: Storage module (lib/storage.ts)
nodes.rationale: All file access goes through it (local uploads/ disk) so it can be swapped for cloud storage later.

nodes.label: F11: Payments
nodes.rationale: Card details never stored; payment code sits behind a small module so a provider can be connected later without other code changes.

nodes.label: F1: Upload and tag photos
nodes.rationale: 50 MB limit sized for 30.4 MP full-frame JPEGs; content-based type check; HEIC converted to JPEG for browser support; RAW not accepted; original + 2000px preview + 400px thumbnail.

nodes.label: F7: Client notifications (email)
nodes.rationale: Batch uploads send one email, not one per photo; client-added photos do not notify.

nodes.norm_label: f8: downloads (shoot photos yes, inspirations no)
nodes.rationale: Clients never receive reference-photo originals, only preview/thumbnail; server checks every file request against the client's access.

nodes.label: Tech stack: local development first
nodes.rationale: Chosen so moving to production means changing settings, not rewriting code.

nodes.label: Spec changelog v0.1-v0.5
nodes.rationale: v0.4 swapped Docker Postgres/Mailpit/Auth.js for PGlite, file outbox and built-in sessions since Docker wasn't installed; v0.5 restored Docker with PGlite/outbox as e2e fallbacks.

nodes.label: Upload route handlers (app/api/admin/...)
nodes.rationale: Server actions are capped at 1 MB, so uploads go through route handlers, one file per request.

nodes.label: Category Type
nodes.rationale: Categories group hooks by purpose, not by event, matching how people search.

nodes.label: HookCard Component
nodes.rationale: Only the repo link is clickable, keeping target and screen-reader text clear.

nodes.label: npm dev/build/lint Commands
nodes.rationale: npm run build is the main type-check gate; no separate tsc script and no test framework yet.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 / React 19 / TS strict / Tailwind v4 Stack
nodes.norm_label: next.js 16 / react 19 / ts strict / tailwind v4 stack

nodes.label: data/hooks.json
nodes.rationale: Single JSON source of truth; no database or runtime fetching; adding a hook is one PR.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes vs training data; block is auto-regenerated by next dev so commit it rather than revert.

nodes.label: HookHub MVP Spec
nodes.rationale: Claude Code hooks are scattered across repos/blogs/lists; HookHub collects them into one browsable static grid.

nodes.label: cacheComponents (next.config.ts)
nodes.rationale: Makes data fetching dynamic by default with opt-in 'use cache'; read caching docs before writing data-fetching code.

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 via Turbopack Loader
nodes.rationale: No PostCSS or tailwind.config; theme tokens (--background/--foreground, Geist fonts) live in app/globals.css via @theme inline.

nodes.label: CODE_REVIEW then PLANNING Workflow
nodes.rationale: Deep-dive review of existing code before changes; preserve variable names and string literals; break changes into discrete tested stages.

nodes.label: Operational Soundness Principle
nodes.rationale: Consider hosting, management, monitoring, maintenance at every step.

nodes.label: Build-time Hook Validation
nodes.rationale: Hand-written validator in lib/hooks.ts avoids new dependency; consider zod if schema grows.

nodes.label: HookHub Security and Trust
nodes.rationale: Hooks run arbitrary code with user permissions; GitHub-only URLs, noopener links, plain-text descriptions, disclaimer footer.

nodes.label: Fully Static Rendering
nodes.rationale: Fast, cheap, easy to host; confirm static in next build output since cacheComponents is enabled.

nodes.label: Desktop GUI window (main-program.py, tkinter)
nodes.rationale: Uses only built-in tkinter so it needs nothing beyond igdl's own dependencies; runs downloader on a background thread so Stop works mid-download and during rate-limit pauses.

nodes.norm_label: custom exceptions mapped to user-friendly cli messages

nodes.label: Guard clauses and early returns
nodes.rationale: Check errors and edge cases at the top of each function and keep the happy path last to avoid nested conditionals.

nodes.label: Rate-limiting and back-off for network scans
nodes.norm_label: rate-limiting and back-off for network scans

nodes.label: Receive an Object, Return an Object (RORO) pattern
nodes.norm_label: receive an object, return an object (roro) pattern

nodes.label: Caption hashtags written to EXIF XPKeywords Tags
nodes.norm_label: caption hashtags written to exif xpkeywords tags
nodes.rationale: XPKeywords is where Windows itself stores Tags, so they show in Explorer Properties/Details and are searchable; image is not re-encoded, so quality and date are unchanged. Duplicates dropped case-insensitively.

nodes.label: Images-only default download filter
nodes.rationale: Video posts are dropped before --limit counts; build_loader disables video files and thumbnails so carousel video slides are skipped too.

nodes.label: --limit with pinned posts (MAX_PINNED = 3)
nodes.rationale: Instagram lists up to 3 pinned posts first regardless of date; reading N+3 and sorting by date keeps old pinned posts from taking the N newest slots.

nodes.label: Public profiles only (no login)
nodes.rationale: No login is supported, so private profiles return exit code 2; login-failed code 3 retired. Scraping is against Instagram ToS, so use only with permission.

nodes.label: Terminal safety (strip control characters)
nodes.rationale: All output, including instaloader caption previews, passes through strip_control so captions cannot inject terminal escape codes.

nodes.label: CODE_REVIEW / PLANNING / SECURITY_REVIEW workflow
nodes.rationale: Review existing code and plan before changing it; do an extra security review whenever input handling or auth is involved.
